title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the reception, conversion and transmission or regeneration of voice, images or other data, including switching and routing apparatus

candidates.rationale: This is the same HS6 subheading as the first choice, covering data conversion and transmission apparatus with a network connection. It is the HS-level counterpart of the CN8 line.

title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the transmission or reception of voice, images or other data (including wired/wireless networks), n.e.c. in item no. 8517.6

candidates.rationale: This is the residual 'other communication apparatus' subheading, which could apply if the dock were not considered to regenerate or convert data.
candidates.set_aside_reason: The dock's conversion and regeneration function fits 8517 62 better than the residual n.e.c. subheading.
